facts.statement: Damage dealt by a machine part card is always applied to the player's shields first, provided the player still has shields remaining.
facts.sourceSentence: Any time a machine part card deals you damage, it will always damage your shields first (if you have any remaining).

facts.statement: Taking damage reduces the value of the player's shield dice first, continuing until those dice are completely expended.
facts.sourceSentence: As damage is taken, reduce the value of shield dice first until they are completely expended (and removed to your spent dice pile).

facts.statement: Shield dice that have been completely expended are removed and placed in the player's spent dice pile.
facts.sourceSentence: As damage is taken, reduce the value of shield dice first until they are completely expended (and removed to your spent dice pile).

facts.statement: Damage left over after the shield dice have absorbed what they can carries over and is applied directly to the player's HP.
facts.sourceSentence: Any remaining damage that hasn't been absorbed by your shield dice will carry over and deal direct damage to your HP.

facts.statement: The win condition is the destruction of the Doom Core.
facts.sourceSentence: You win the game when the Doom Core has been destroyed.

facts.statement: Clearing every machine part card is not required in order to win.
facts.sourceSentence: You don't have to clear all of the machine part cards to win.

facts.statement: If the player's HP drops to zero, the player is destroyed by the machine and loses the game.
facts.sourceSentence: However, if your HP is reduced to zero, the machine destroys you first, and you lose.
